rows.en:
{C:81939B00}{C:81958296541E00000000}It looks like the Astante has arrived.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296561E00000000}So it seems.
Does this mean
history can be changed now?

{C:81939B00}{C:81958296571E00000000}I am merely a witness to history.
But... things are about to get interesting.
Heh heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha ha!





{x00}

{C:8193B200}{C:81958296581E00000000}This is the Titans.
To the unidentified ship: this is a warning.
Do not approach any closer.

{C:81958296591E00000000}If you fail to obey this warning,
we will remove you by force.

{C:819582965A1E00000000}I repeat.
This is the Titans...




{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:819582965F1E00000000}Welcome to Von Braun.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296601E00000000}Thank you
for allowing us to dock.
I'm Captain Rie Akatsuki.


{C:81908400}{C:81958296611E00000000}You're the captain?!
...No, forgive me.

{C:81958296621E00000000}I am Captain Quattro Bajeena
of AEUG.
We welcome your ship into port.

{C:81958296631E00000000}Please, make yourselves comfortable for now.
I have some business to attend to,
so let's talk later.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296641E00000000}Yes.
Thank you very much.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296651E00000000}That Quattro fellow...
I feel like I've seen him before.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296661E00000000}So, what are we going to do?
Since we're here, why don't we find out
what's going on in this city?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296671E00000000}Good idea.
Let's do that.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296681E00000000}Hmph! I'm coming too, you know.



{x00}

{C:81908200}{C:81958296691E00000000}Hey, you lot!
You're the crew of that battleship that just docked, right?

{C:819582966A1E00000000}Since you've docked at Von Braun,
you're going to help AEUG, of course, right?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966B1E00000000}No, we're...

{C:81908200}{C:819582966C1E00000000}You're not?! I see!
You're going to help the Titans,
just like Posaydal's army!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966D1E00000000}Help them? We don't even know
what the Titans are.

{C:81908200}{C:819582966E1E00000000}Shut up!
Don't lie to me!

{C:81900300}{C:819582966F1E00000000}Big brother...
This guy seems dangerous.

{C:81958296701E00000000}Aaah!
He's coming at us!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296711E00000000}Move!



{x00}

{C:81900300}{C:81958296741E00000000}Nelfea, you're amazing!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296751E00000000}D-don't get the wrong idea.
I was only protecting the captain
and a certain unreliable person.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296761E00000000}Well, whatever the reason, you saved us.
Thanks, Nelfea.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296771E00000000}I-it's fine.
He might come back,
so let's go somewhere else.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296781E00000000}Yeah!




{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296801E00000000}It seems {C:819782830400}Kamille{C:819782830000} behaved rudely earlier.
I'm sorry.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296811E00000000}Kamille?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296821E00000000}He must mean that guy from before.
You know, the one who tried to punch us.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296831E00000000}Oh.
Is he someone you know,
Captain Quattro?


{C:81908400}{C:81958296841E00000000}He's a talented pilot,
but rather headstrong.
Even we have trouble handling him.

{C:81958296851E00000000}I've set him straight.
In light of that, would you be willing
to hear me out?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296861E00000000}With all due respect,
someone who resorts to violence
against people he's just met...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296871E00000000}Stop it, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296881E00000000}But...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296891E00000000}Captain Quattro's apologizing, too.
Besides, we don't know the situation
on this continent, do we?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968A1E00000000}Right, right.
Big brother's right.

{C:81900400}{C:819582968B1E00000000}Oh, you're just obsessed with your brother.

{C:81900300}{C:819582968C1E00000000}What was that?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D1E00000000}Both of you, stop it.
You're embarrassing yourselves.

{C:819582968E1E00000000}Sorry, Captain Quattro.
Could you tell us what you wanted to say?

{C:81908400}{C:819582968F1E00000000}Thank you.
Let's go somewhere else so we can talk at leisure.
Come along.






{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296901E00000000}So the Titans have joined forces with Posaydal's army,
and we in AEUG
are being driven into a corner.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296911E00000000}I see.
So you need all the fighting strength
you can get?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296931E00000000}That is part of it...
but I'm concerned about a presence I sense
behind this conflict.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296941E00000000}What do you think it is,
Captain Quattro?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296951E00000000}...An enemy other than Posaydal
or the Titans.

{C:81958296961E00000000}I see it as a third force,
so to speak.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296971E00000000}A third force...?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296981E00000000}I suspect that the enemy we must fight
is that presence
behind the scenes.

{C:81958296991E00000000}It's only a hunch, though.

{C:81930100}{C:819582969A1E00000000}Captain Quattro, have you ever seen
a ship with the same shape
as ours?

{C:81908400}{C:819582969B1E00000000}A ship of the same type...
I've heard reports that one landed in another city.

{C:819582969C1E00000000}I understand they're hostile to you.
Am I wrong?

{C:81900300}{C:819582969D1E00000000}You're quite right.
We crossed the Cloud Sea
in pursuit of that ship.

{C:81908400}{C:819582969E1E00000000}Then I would like your help.
No, rather, I'd like you to let us help you.
What do you say?


{C:81900400}{C:819582969F1E00000000}What do we do, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A21E00000000}Well... Wait,
what?! I have to decide?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A31E00000000}Of course. You're the captain.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A41E00000000}...All right, Captain Quattro.
We'll help you.


{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A51E00000000}Thank you, Rie.
To get straight to the point, there's something
I'd like to provide you with. Please accept it.

{C:81958296A61E00000000}I'll go on ahead and wait for you at the {C:819782830300}airport{C:819782830000}.
I'll see you
there later.


{C:81900300}{C:81958296A71E00000000}What do you think he wants to give us?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A81E00000000}Maybe it's their equivalent
of a GT or FT.
What do you think, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A91E00000000}I think it might be a ship
to replace the Astante.
This continent's ships are more convenient.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AA1E00000000}Whatever it is,
we'll find out at the airport.




{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A03600000000}You're here.
First, let me introduce someone.
This is Kamille Bidan.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296A13600000000}I'm sorry about earlier.
I'm Kamille Bidan.
I'll be traveling with you from now on.

{C:81958296A23600000000}You can just
call me Kamille.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A33600000000}Whaaaaat?!

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A43600000000}Now, don't say that.
I'll be accompanying you as well.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A53600000000}Well, that's fine, then...

{C:81908300}{C:81958296A63600000000}Captain Quattro,
please introduce me too.
How could you forget me?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A73600000000}Ah, yes. I'm sorry. This is 
{C:819782830400}Fa Yuiry{C:819782830000}.

{C:81908300}{C:81958296A83600000000}I'm Fa Yuiry.
Nice to meet you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A93600000000}Oh, nice to meet you too.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296AA3600000000}Now, as for what I wanted to give you, I've arranged for the 
{C:819782830400}Audhumla{C:819782830000} aircraft.
It's ready for you.

{C:81958296AB3600000000}The Audhumla
can dock anywhere.
Feel free to use it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC3600000000}Thank you,
Captain Quattro!

{C:81908400}{C:81958296AD3600000000}I'm counting on you, too.



{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296AE3600000000}First, you should go to {C:819782830300}Green Noa{C:819782830000}.
The Titans' influence there
is still weak.




{x00}

{C:81938700}{C:81958296261F00000000}This is a Titans garrison.
Civilians are not allowed inside.
Leave immediately.





{x00}

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296B81E00000000}You! What do you think you're doing
to a Titans uniform?!
You've got the baby's drool all over it!

{C:8193DA02}{C:81958296B91E00000000}Oh, I'm so sorry!
She's only a baby.
She doesn't understand.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296BA1E00000000}That bastard!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BB1E00000000}K-Kamille!
What are you going to do?!



{x00}

{C:81908200}{C:81958296BC1E00000000}You think being in the Titans
makes you that important?!

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296BE1E00000000}You bastard! Kamille!


{x00}

{C:81908200}{C:81958296C31E00000000}We're getting out of here too!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C41E00000000}What?!
Why do we have to run too?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296C51E00000000}AEUG and the Titans
are enemies!
Do you want to get arrested?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C61E00000000}That was pretty cool, Kamille.
A little too sudden, though.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296C71E00000000}Thanks.




{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C81E00000000}We got away,
but I lost everyone.

{C:81958296C91E00000000}Oh, well.
I've got a car. I'll look around on my own.




{x00}

{C:8190A102}{C:819582964C1F00000000}Excuse me.
Have you seen a boy around here
about my age?

{C:81930100}{C:819582964D1F00000000}A boy about your age?
Hmm... I see boys like that
all over the place.

{C:8190A102}{C:819582964E1F00000000}Right...
He doesn't exactly stand out.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964F1F00000000}Sorry
I couldn't help.

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296501F00000000}It's fine, it's fine.
Thanks anyway.








{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CD1E00000000}...{C:819782830400}Amuro{C:819782830000}?

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296CE1E00000000}Yes, I'm Amuro Ray.
And you are...
No, we've never met before, have we?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CF1E00000000}No.
It's strange, when we've only just met.

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296D01E00000000}Yes.
It feels as though I've known you for years.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D11E00000000}I feel the same way, Mr. Amuro.

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296D21E00000000}Just Amuro is fine.
Somehow that feels more natural.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D31E00000000}All right.

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296D41E00000000}{C:819782830400}The elecar{C:819782830000} isn't running, right?
I'll take a look for you.



{x00}

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E11E00000000}Oh, you're back!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E21E00000000}Where have you been wandering off to?!
We had a terrible time
in a city we don't even know!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E31E00000000}Sorry, sorry.
I was running so desperately
that I ended up back at the airport.

{C:81958296E41E00000000}I couldn't help it,
so I went around on my own.


{C:81900300}{C:81958296E51E00000000}No fair!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E61E00000000}No fair!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E71E00000000}I'll be more careful next time.
Please forgive me.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E81E00000000}Very well.
In that case, I shall forgive you.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E91E00000000}Oh, all right.
I forgive you.



{x00}

{C:81939500}{C:81958296EA1E00000000}What's this rough, grating sensation?
Is there an enemy with a presence like this...?
It's disgusting!


{x00}

{C:81908200}{C:81958296EB1E00000000}You're going into Hong Kong, right?
I'll give you a ride in the elecar.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EC1E00000000}Thanks. That'd be a big help.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296ED1E00000000}What about us?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EE1E00000000}We can come along too, of course, right?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296EF1E00000000}You're going to stick together anyway, aren't you?
I don't mind.
Then let's go to {C:819782830300}Main Street{C:819782830000}.




{x00}

{C:81908200}{C:81958296F01E00000000}Is somewhere around here all right?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F11E00000000}Thanks, Kamille.
See you later.


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F21E00000000}Right, let's go.

{C:81958296F31E00000000}...Huh? A girl's walking over
to Kamille's elecar.


{C:81909500}{C:81958296F41E00000000}Hey, could you give me a ride to the airport?

{C:81938200}{C:81958296F51E00000000}Sure, no problem.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296F61E00000000}That helps. Thanks.


{x00}

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F71E00000000}Oh, they've gone.
I wonder if they know each other.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F81E00000000}Well, never mind.
Let's get going too.




{x00}

{C:81909500}{C:81958296F91E00000000}Thanks.
Hey, can you tell me your name?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FA1E00000000}I'm Kamille.
Nice to meet you.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296FB1E00000000}Kamille, huh?
That's a gentle name.

{C:81908200}......

{C:81909500}{C:81958296FC1E00000000}Ha ha ha ha ha!
You don't like your name, do you?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FD1E00000000}How can you tell?

{C:81909500}{C:81958296FE1E00000000}It's written all over your face.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FF1E00000000}We'll see each other again, won't we?

{C:81909500}{C:81958296001F00000000}Again... I'd like that.
Bye.



{x00}

{C:81908200}{C:81958296271F00000000}...So it seems AEUG
is short on fighting strength, Captain.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296281F00000000}I see...
If only we had Amuro Ray.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296291F00000000}(Did Captain Quattro
just say Amuro?)

{C:819582962A1F00000000}Sorry to interrupt, Captain Quattro.
Did you just mention Amuro?

{C:81908400}{C:819582962B1F00000000}Oh, it's you.
Yes, I did.
Does that mean something to you?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962C1F00000000}Yes, if the person I met
wasn't lying to me.
It's just...

{C:81908400}{C:819582962D1F00000000}Just what?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962E1F00000000}He didn't seem
like someone who fights.

{C:81908400}{C:819582962F1F00000000}He didn't seem
like a fighter...?
I see... Perhaps you're right.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296301F00000000}Captain Quattro, why don't you
at least try meeting him?

{C:81958296311F00000000}I'm interested in meeting
the hero of the One Year War myself.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296321F00000000}You're right.
Sorry to ask, but could you go to {C:819782830300}Green Noa{C:819782830000}
for me?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296331F00000000}All right.
You want us to head
to Green Noa, then.



{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296341F00000000}It would be better not to visit Amuro
with a large group.
Could I ask you to go?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296351F00000000}I don't mind,
but I'm not confident
I can persuade him.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296361F00000000}Would it be better
if we didn't go either?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296371F00000000}Yes.
I think one person would be best.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296381F00000000}You heard him.
That means you can't go either,
Nelfea!

{C:81900400}{C:819582963B1F00000000}(She beat me to it...)

{C:81930100}{C:819582963C1F00000000}Well, I'll be off.





{x00}

{C:81938800}{C:81958296B03600000000}Why, Amuro?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B13600000000}Huh?
Amuro has a visitor.
I'll wait a bit.

{C:81908800}{C:81958296B33600000000}I'm asking you
why you won't fight!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296B43600000000}...I fought enough in the One Year War.

{C:81908800}{C:81958296B63600000000}Don't say that!
Tell me you've got even a single MS
hidden underground!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296B73600000000}{C:819782830400}Katz{C:819782830000}...

{C:81908800}{C:81958296B83600000000}Amuro, to think you'd act like this...!!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296BA3600000000}Katz!
He's gone...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BB3600000000}Um... Amuro?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296BD3600000000}Oh, it's you.
What brings you here today?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE3600000000}Actually, I've come to ask you a favor.
I'm from another continent
called Claudia.


{C:81908A00}{C:81958296BF3600000000}Hm?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C03600000000}I'm helping AEUG now,
fighting the Titans.


{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C13600000000}You are?!
...So,
what do you want me to do?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C33600000000}I heard you're a hero
of the One Year War seven years ago.
I'd really like your help.

{C:81958296C43600000000}Please.
Would you help us?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C63600000000}You heard what I said earlier, didn't you?
I think I fought enough
in the One Year War.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296471F00000000}I see.
...That's a shame.

{C:81958296C83600000000}Well, I'll come again.
Just to visit next time.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C93600000000}Thank you for understanding.
You're always welcome.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CA3600000000}Thank you.




{x00}

{C:81900100}{C:81958296C33600000000}I heard you're a hero
of the One Year War seven years ago.
I'd really like your help.

{C:81958296C43600000000}Please.
Would you help us?

{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296591F00000000}Sigh... Amuro...
I couldn't bring him along...

{C:81905700}{C:819582965A1F00000000}You're late!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B1F00000000}Whoa!
W-what?!

{C:81905700}{C:819582965C1F00000000}Get moving!
Dawdling on the battlefield is dangerous!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965D1F00000000}Y-yes!
Wait, who are you?

{C:81905700}{C:819582965E1F00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Gaw Ha Leccee.{C:819782830000}
I've just joined the group.
Nice to meet you!

{C:81900300}{C:819582965F1F00000000}Oh, welcome back, big brother.
This is Leccee. She's just joined us.

{C:81958296601F00000000}And this is my older brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296611F00000000}Nice to meet you.
I'm looking forward to working with you.




{x00}

{C:81900300}{C:81958296631F00000000}Captain Quattro spoke to us.
We're transferring back to the Astante,
so get ready too, big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296641F00000000}That's sudden again.
Did something happen?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296661F00000000}Apparently, the Titans
have stepped up their activity.

{C:81958296681F00000000}So AEUG seems
to need more fighting strength.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296691F00000000}That's how it is,
so hurry up and get ready!
Understood?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966A1F00000000}Y-yes, I understand.

{C:819582966B1F00000000}(Leccee sure is
an energetic person.)





{x00}

{C:81908800}{C:81958296D23600000000}Amuro, you're here?!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296D53600000000}Katz...

{C:81908800}{C:81958296D63600000000}I wasn't sure what to do either.
But if you're going, Amuro,
I'm coming with you.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296D93600000000}{C:819782830400}Fraw{C:819782830000} will object.
What mother wants to send her child into battle?

{C:81908800}{C:81958296DB3600000000}I persuaded my mother.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296DD3600000000}In that case, I won't say anything.

{C:81958296DF3600000000}Then please take Katz along too.
Is that all right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E03600000000}All right.






{x00}

{C:81938400}{C:81958296731F00000000}...That's the situation.
The greatest threat to us
is Hong Kong City's {C:819782830400}Psyco Gundam{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296741F00000000}Unless we do something about it,
our operations will...


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296761F00000000}Captain Quattro, a woman calling herself 
{C:819782830400}Emma Sheen{C:819782830000}
is on the line.

{C:81938400}{C:81958296771F00000000}Lieutenant Emma?
Put her through.

{C:81938700}{C:81958296781F00000000}I have a report.

{C:81958296791F00000000}A machine from another continent has flown over 
{C:819782830300}Kilimanjaro{C:819782830000}.
It's in the air above it.

{C:81938400}{C:819582967A1F00000000}Can you identify the type, Lieutenant Emma?

{C:81938700}{C:819582967B1F00000000}Apparently, it's called a {C:819782830400}Brain{C:819782830000}.
It seems to be connected to a man and a woman
captured by the Titans.

{C:819582967D1F00000000}If possible, please rescue them
from the Titans.

{C:81938400}{C:819582967E1F00000000}Understood.
We'll watch for the right opportunity
to head to Kilimanjaro.






{x00}

{C:81908700}{C:81958296891F00000000}Thank you for your efforts, Captain Quattro.

{C:81908400}{C:819582968A1F00000000}It wasn't my doing, Lieutenant Emma.
It's all thanks to them.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968C1F00000000}That's not true.
We couldn't have done anything
with just our own strength.

{C:81908700}{C:819582968D1F00000000}You're being modest.
I like that.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296901F00000000}Someone's calling me... I'll step out for a bit!




{x00}
